Intro: What's good, Chef? Thinking of becoming a regular here, even told some friends about this place. Only store around that don't feel rotten to the core.
Redwall Street kids might be rough around the edges, but we know how to treat a good one right. Don't worry about us causing any trouble.
Oh right! When I told my Ma about this place, she told me how she wished she could see this place for herself, so I'm thinking of surprising her.
Got any food that's easy to eat in bed? Don't want her to worry about making any kind of mess.
Success: Thanks, Chef! Looks like she will love this!
Fail: Hey, hey, Chef, what are you doing?! I can't give to my Ma. This looks like shit!
Reject: Really? Over takeout? You have to be fucking kidding me.
